title: Mark Bible Quiz - Chapter 2
description: Ten questions on Mark 2: the paralytic let down through the roof, the calling of Levi, the question about fasting and the Sabbath in the grain fields.

questions.text: How did the four people get the paralytic to Jesus?
questions.explanation: Because they could not come near for the crowd, they removed the roof, broke it up, and let down the mat the paralytic was lying on.

answers.text: They removed the roof and let his mat down
They carried him through the door
They called Jesus out into the street
They waited until the crowd had left

questions.text: What did Jesus say to the paralytic when he saw their faith?
questions.explanation: Jesus, seeing their faith, said to the paralytic, "Son, your sins are forgiven you."

answers.text: "Your faith has made you well."
"Go and show yourself to the priest."
"Son, your sins are forgiven you."
"Do you believe that I can do this?"

questions.text: What did the scribes sitting there reason about Jesus?
questions.explanation: They reasoned in their hearts that he spoke blasphemies, asking who can forgive sins but God alone.

answers.text: That he healed by the power of Moses
That he blasphemed, since God alone can forgive sins
That he was a prophet sent from God
That he had broken the Sabbath day

questions.text: What did Jesus tell the paralytic to do?
questions.explanation: He said, "I tell you, arise, take up your mat, and go to your house."

answers.text: Go and wash in the sea
Stay and listen to his teaching
Tell no one what had happened
Arise, take up his mat and go home

questions.text: Whom did Jesus call while he was sitting at the tax office?
questions.explanation: As he passed by, he saw Levi, the son of Alphaeus, sitting at the tax office, and said to him, "Follow me."

answers.text: Levi, the son of Alphaeus
Simon the Zealot
James the son of Zebedee
Jairus the synagogue ruler

questions.text: What did Jesus answer those who asked why he ate with tax collectors and sinners?
questions.explanation: He said that the healthy have no need for a physician, but those who are sick, and that he came not to call the righteous but sinners to repentance.

answers.text: The law allows eating with anyone
He eats with whoever invites him
A physician is for the sick, not the healthy
Only the righteous can be taught

questions.text: What did Jesus say about fasting while the bridegroom is present?
questions.explanation: He said the groomsmen cannot fast as long as they have the bridegroom with them.

answers.text: They must fast twice a week
The groomsmen cannot fast then
They should fast after the meal
They fast only for the bridegroom

questions.text: What happens when new wine is put into old wineskins?
questions.explanation: The new wine bursts the skins, the wine pours out, and the skins are destroyed; new wine is put into fresh wineskins.

answers.text: The skins burst and the wine is lost
The wine turns sour but keeps
The old skins grow strong again
The wine becomes better with age

questions.text: What did the disciples do on the Sabbath that the Pharisees objected to?
questions.explanation: As they went through the grain fields on the Sabbath day, the disciples began to pluck the ears of grain.

answers.text: They lit a fire in the field
They carried water from a well
They traveled far from the city
They plucked ears of grain

questions.text: What did Jesus say about the Sabbath and man?
questions.explanation: He said, "The Sabbath was made for man, not man for the Sabbath."

answers.text: Man was made for the Sabbath
The Sabbath was made for man
The Sabbath was made for the priests
The Sabbath was given to David
